summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload disguised as math_init.js
details: The package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the package. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line opaque blob using a shift-based string-array decoder (WV8StW); its name has no relation to the package's advertised datetime utility purpose and contains no datetime or math functionality. Executing an obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime fetched at install time bypasses Node-based module and scanner instrumentation, so the payload's true behavior is not observable via normal Node hooks. The package is published under the @servicetitan npm scope with repository and homepage links pointing to ServiceTitan internal properties (servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib, docs.st.dev), consistent with impersonation of an internal scope rather than a first-party release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
